rows.invariant: G2: no path, no claim (a suspect with no causal path is eliminated)
G5: a suspect whose max flow cannot carry the observed impact is eliminated
G1: the cause must have been seen in a graph result of this run
approval is bound to the exact plan hash (choosing ≠ approving)
execute refuses a stored action that no longer matches its approved plan hash
verification that cannot read a channel is UNKNOWN, never success
write-back never records success for an UNKNOWN verification
learned remediation ordering only reorders enabled options (disabled ones never move)
a bystander change is not confirmed when the anomaly shows only at the symptom (G4 origin)
G5's bound counts every failure path (min(1, k × maxFlow)), so reconvergent paths cannot fake an elimination
a change on the alerting component itself is always a suspect (Q-SUS-1 keeps the symptom row)
every template read goes through GRAPH.RO_QUERY
FAULTLINE_DISABLE_GRAPH=true makes every read fail loudly (ablation arm A4; two guards, both removed)
templates may not contain write clauses
guarded text2cypher rejects write keywords
the brain's citation guard refuses ids no tool call of the question returned
tenant names are validated (no cross-tenant or injected graph names)
